commands:
set -eu
KEY="$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519"
TARGET="356289656d66963fb7451b70eac2e1bcff015819"
PRE_SPRINT="30bff5c930e9cff13b52f9bff67dc3e21ea06798"
OLD_HASH="5177a82937d38c8d2ba5b8a41156b30354f523b5c293a203d0b6ef62a5af78b5"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 "TARGET='$TARGET' PRE_SPRINT='$PRE_SPRINT' OLD_HASH='$OLD_HASH' bash -s" <<'PI_SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
BACKUP=".dev/deploy/unified-ux-20261104-09be8c4"
UNDO=".dev/deploy/unified-ux-rollback-20261104-3562896"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "4c2694dc9623873782de326cbefdf7e8b94c4bdb"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(sha256sum "$BACKUP/index-before.html" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$OLD_HASH"
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "ccc80c6f664853030e4674dfc783ec1607a9923e823b10f35b221a7348e48a1d"
test -d "$BACKUP/dist-before"
test -f "$BACKUP/app-before.db"
test "$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl is-active cloudflared.service)" = active
OLD_PID=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value photomap.service)
OLD_TUNNEL_PID=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value cloudflared.service)
test "$OLD_PID" -gt 0
test "$OLD_TUNNEL_PID" -gt 0
test ! -e "$UNDO"
mkdir -p "$UNDO"
cp -a frontend/dist "$UNDO/dist-ux-before-rollback"
printf '%s\n' "$OLD_PID" > "$UNDO/backend-pid-before.txt"
printf '%s\n' "$OLD_TUNNEL_PID" > "$UNDO/tunnel-pid-before.txt"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$UNDO/head-before.sha"
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$TARGET"
test "$(git rev-parse "$TARGET^{tree}")" = "$(git rev-parse "$PRE_SPRINT^{tree}")"
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "PI_SOURCE_ROLLBACK_APPLIED=$TARGET"
rsync -a --exclude=index.html "$BACKUP/dist-before/" frontend/dist/
cp "$BACKUP/index-before.html" frontend/dist/index.html.rollback-next
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html.rollback-next | awk '{print $1}')" = "$OLD_HASH"
OLD_ASSET=$(grep -oE 'assets/public-map-[^" ]+\.js' frontend/dist/index.html.rollback-next | head -1)
test -n "$OLD_ASSET"
test -f "frontend/dist/$OLD_ASSET"
echo "ROLLBACK_ASSET_READY=$OLD_ASSET"
mv -f frontend/dist/index.html.rollback-next frontend/dist/index.html
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$OLD_HASH"
test "$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value photomap.service)" = "$OLD_PID"
test "$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value cloudflared.service)" = "$OLD_TUNNEL_PID"
test "$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl is-active cloudflared.service)" = active
curl -fsS --max-time 12 -o "$UNDO/local-index.html" http://127.0.0.1:8000/
grep -F "$OLD_ASSET" "$UNDO/local-index.html" >/dev/null
curl -fsS --max-time 12 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health > "$UNDO/local-health.json"
curl -fsS --max-time 12 -o /dev/null -w "LOCAL_MAP_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/places/map
curl -fsS --max-time 12 -o /dev/null -w "LOCAL_OLD_BUNDLE_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:8000/$OLD_ASSET"
echo "PI_ACTIVE_INDEX_SHA=$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "PI_MAIN_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PI_BACKEND_PID=$OLD_PID"
echo "PI_TUNNEL_PID=$OLD_TUNNEL_PID"
echo "PI_PRODUCTION_ROLLBACK_PASS"
PI_SCRIPT
curl -fsS --max-time 15 -o /tmp/photomap-rollback-public-20261104.html https://photomap.pl/
grep -F "assets/public-map-D41-GBxF.js" /tmp/photomap-rollback-public-20261104.html >/dev/null
curl -fsS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "PUBLIC_HEALTH_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" https://photomap.pl/health
curl -fsS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "PUBLIC_MAP_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" https://photomap.pl/api/places/map
curl -fsS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "PUBLIC_OLD_MAP_BUNDLE_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" https://photomap.pl/assets/public-map-D41-GBxF.js
echo "PUBLIC_PREVIOUS_UX_RESTORED"
